user_mgmt_2fa_reset_tip: After reset, the user must set up 2FA again
user_mgmt_2fa_help: Enable TOTP two-factor authentication when signing in on a new device (e.g., Microsoft/Google Authenticator). This will enhance account security significantly.
user_mgmt_2fa_disable_confirm: Disable 2FA for this user? This will clear the secret and require re-binding.
user_mgmt_2fa_bind_tip: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (e.g., Microsoft/Google Authenticator), then enter the code to enable 2FA.
user_mgmt_2fa_create_hint: Click “Create” to generate secret and QR code
user_mgmt_add_auth_dir_alert: If a subdirectory of an existing directory is added, the permissions will be based on the parent directory.
user_mgmt_add_auth_dir_hint: To set permissions for photos, movies, etc., simply authorize the source directory or its subdirectories of the corresponding module.
user_delete_confirm_message: Are you sure you want to delete this user?
